type.description: The device the profile applies to.

ssid.description: The network name. Required for wifi and refused for ethernet.

caCert.description: A PEM certificate in the resource root, placed where NetworkManager reads it. Omitted, the system trust store is used.

clientCert.description: Where the fleet places this machine's client certificate, for EAP-TLS. /etc/pki/tls is the platform's PKI tree and its files carry cert_t, which NetworkManager is allowed to read. A path, never an asset: the certificate names the machine.

privateKey.description: Where the fleet places this machine's private key, for EAP-TLS. The private tree carries cert_t, so the key is not left with the generic etc_t a new directory would get. Never image content.

identity.description: The account the network authenticates. NetworkManager refuses a password profile without one; a TLS profile does not need it. Not a secret, but every machine of the image shares it.

secret.description: agent: NetworkManager asks a session agent, so the profile works after a login, not at boot. none: EAP-TLS, which needs no secret and joins before login.

serverName.description: The name the authentication server's certificate must present (domain-suffix-match).

autoconnect.description: Whether the machine joins this network on its own. Default true.

priority.description: Ranking among profiles that autoconnect. Default 0.
